changes.active_actions: Add194 timed native action adaptations:146 receptions and48 raised-foot strikes from5 untouched source motions plus mirrors. Bake smooth leg reach in joint rotations with fixed anatomical link lengths, opposite-leg support IK, and ballistic root arcs for jumps up to.64 m. Keep original native ground locomotion and action entry/smoothing. Runtime contact markers are rebound to weighted skin and accepted only through the existing millimetre plan/event gates.
changes.receiver_decisions: Lift the CPU reception priority height limit from1.55 to2.65 m; allow early reachable receiver assignment before native possession designation catches up. Search each10 ms physics tick for reachable incoming airborne balls, in automatic player controls and CPU. Preserve deliberate pass/shot/cross requests and use raised native strikes for airborne foot actions without changing original offensive headers.
changes.receiving_while_dribbling: Allow a nearby elevated own nonkicked control to trigger another receiving attempt, including transition out of completed ball control; deliberately kicked passes/shots stay excluded. Prefer an elevated foot for low arrivals and thigh candidates where height is suitable; geometric skin feasibility remains final.
changes.meeting_point: Neutral human receiving input uses the full future trajectory at receiving height. It no longer runs toward a200 ms projection while the ball remains overhead, overshooting its actual reception point. CPU and human preserve bounded adjustments and orientation without teleporting the ball or giving proximity possession.
changes.head_cushion: Head-domain adaptations use a smooth32-frame withdrawal of native preparation after impact, instead of the hard header follow-through. Cushion ahead of the actual body, not an idle approach vector that may point backwards. Original offensive heading actions remain separate.
changes.walking_response: Interrupt human slow-walking movement cycles on release or reversal after the initial preparation, using the full native transition from the factual current root. Generic action requeue kept old walking paths and sub1.5m/s movement optimizations previously ignored stop input. A new rendered650ms test requires less than.25m drift and speed below.20m/s; loaded shirt holding retains its unchanged25% slowdown and actual hand reach thresholds.
changes.body_duels: On a real closing body-surface contact, add equal opposing impact impulses from reduced mass42 kg and relative normal speed, capped240 N.s with500 ms episode cooldown, alongside existing continuous pressure. Feed the real contact lever to both balance controllers. Correct contact-pair key lifetime; normal sustained pressure alone still does not force a fall.
changes.weight_transfer: Increase acceleration-driven torso weight shift and damped base lean with planted-foot IK, retaining anatomical arm limits, camera head orientation, native action contact poses and authored recovery. No Unity locomotion imports or new model training.
changes.tests: Add graphical regressions that demand intentional airborne skin events, visible leg extension and both feet off ground for actual human/CPU jumps. Verify real duel impulses and rendered torso/support reactions in both bodies without usingF8. Add15 numeric reach/link-length/ballistic-jump checks. New airborne pass/shot/cross fixtures send input before arrival instead of consuming flight time waiting for two X11 acknowledgements.

learned_motor.algorithm: cross-entropy neural policy search on perturbed angular dynamics
learned_motor.scope: Learned upper-body angular servo with native motion references and domain-randomized reduced dynamics. Not Euphoria, AMP, a trained whole-body locomotion/balance policy, or proof of full-body sim-to-game transfer.

superseded_test_outcomes.reason: The fixed250ms world-Y approach could miss actual shirt reach; grasping during its subsequent gait-to-idle transition could also break the hand constraint before a loaded hold developed. The final fixture approaches the real rendered partner, waits for measured braking/settling, then changes ownership with LT held and acquires an actual hand contact before applying an opposing analog pull. All acquisition/release/force/slowdown limits remain unchanged.

superseded_test_outcomes.reason: The old anti-suspension classifier counted any high ball near the receiver, including a visibly rising/falling bounce. The failed sample rose.743->.98m then fell.915->.166m; this was not suspension. The final check additionally measures vertical speed below.35m/s while retaining its original height/gap/fraction limits. The same real collision/airborne-action checks remain.

investigated_findings: Previous upper-body reference blending and passive collision checks did not prove intentional interception. The new action bank participates in actual selection and its events must meet the real ball on the same skin used for rendering.
CPU reception priority stopped below1.55 m. Narrow incoming-speed/body-direction bins and40-80 ms scheduling could also reject or skip a legal airborne contact, despite an available original action.

The200 ms horizontal interception estimate made a neutral human receiver run forward under a ball still overhead, moving beyond the actual receiving point. Full trajectory interception at feasible receiving height fixes the observed player/CPU jump failures without widening the final skin tolerance.

An idle adjustment direction can point backwards. Using it to cushion a head ball directed the ball back into its own forehead. Actual body direction plus a gradual withdrawal of the source preparation prevents the repeated head collisions in the new fixed trials.

Pressure capped260 N produces at most2.6 N.s per10 ms tick, below the protective-step trigger. A distinct reciprocal closing-contact impulse now visibly recruits both bodies in actual sprint challenges.

The first new shot/cross fixtures waited for two X11 keyboard acknowledgements before sending the controller button, using most of the420 ms flight. Input is now sent after delivery acknowledgement and before key release; observed action timing confirms actual airborne foot contact.
All retained graphical release cases below use the final native executable hash. Earlier exploratory binaries and their successes/failures are excluded from release pass counts.
limits: Graphical tests run on Linux/X11 with a virtual Xbox controller. Windows is cross-compiled and its complete portable archive, imports and media are checked; Windows runtime/controller feel still requires the user PC.

The approved neural motor remains a small upper-body angular servo with18 parameters, not machine-learned full-body locomotion. The new reach, jump and impact systems are analytical and are not proprietary Euphoria.
The194 runtime adaptations are derived motions, not194 new captures or hundreds of thousands of new animations. Existing source animation hashes and procedural-profile asset counts remain preserved.

These fixed scenarios establish specific real airborne contacts, jumps and physical reactions; they do not prove control of every possible ball or universal absence of interpenetration. Unreachable or hard/backside arrivals can still be lost.
Physical mode remains opt-in through treino-fisico.bat/partida-fisica.bat. Approved ordinary launchers keep their previous physical-layer-off defaults.
